## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    // Uniform scale.
    Multiply(left: Vector3D, scalar: Number): Vector3D
        => (left.X * scalar, left.Y * scalar, left.Z * scalar);

    // Uniform scale with the scalar on the left.
    Multiply(scalar: Number, right: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (scalar * right.X, scalar * right.Y, scalar * right.Z);

    // Per-axis scale by a triple of factors.
    Multiply(left: Vector3D, factors: Number3): Vector3D
        => (left.X * factors.X, left.Y * factors.Y, left.Z * factors.Z);

    // Uniform division. Dividing by zero yields infinite or NaN components.
    Divide(left: Vector3D, scalar: Number): Vector3D
        => (left.X / scalar, left.Y / scalar, left.Z / scalar);

    // The vector pointing the opposite way.
    Negative(value: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (-value.X, -value.Y, -value.Z);

    // The dot product. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dot_product
    Dot(self: Vector3D, right: Vector3D): Number
        => self.X * right.X + self.Y * right.Y + self.Z * right.Z;

    // The cross product: the vector perpendicular to both operands, with
    // magnitude equal to the area of the parallelogram they span.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_product
    Cross(self: Vector3D, right: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (self.Y * right.Z - self.Z * right.Y,
            self.Z * right.X - self.X * right.Z,
            self.X * right.Y - self.Y * right.X);

    // The reflection of the vector off a plane with the given normal:
    // v - 2 (v . n) n. Precondition: `normal` is unit length.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reflection_(mathematics)
    Reflect(self: Vector3D, normal: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => self - normal * (2.0 * self.Dot(normal));

    //==
    // Vector3D — transformation

    // Apply a homogeneous map, including the translation row (Row4):
    // v' = x Row1 + y Row2 + z Row3 + Row4, dropping the w component.
    Transform(self: Vector3D, matrix: Matrix4x4): Vector3D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + self.Z * matrix.Row3.X + matrix.Row4.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Y + matrix.Row4.Y,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Z + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Z + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Z + matrix.Row4.Z);

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): matrix * self.
    Multiply(matrix: Matrix4x4, self: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => self.Transform(matrix);

    // Rotate the vector by a quaternion: the doubled-component expansion of the
    // sandwich product q v q*.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation
    Transform(self: Vector3D, rotation: Quaternion): Vector3D {
        var x2 = rotation.X + rotation.X;
        var y2 = rotation.Y + rotation.Y;
        var z2 = rotation.Z + rotation.Z;
        var wx2 = rotation.W * x2;
        var wy2 = rotation.W * y2;
        var wz2 = rotation.W * z2;
        var xx2 = rotation.X * x2;
        var xy2 = rotation.X * y2;
        var xz2 = rotation.X * z2;
        var yy2 = rotation.Y * y2;
        var yz2 = rotation.Y * z2;
        var zz2 = rotation.Z * z2;
        return (self.X * (1.0 - yy2 - zz2) + self.Y * (xy2 - wz2) + self.Z * (xz2 + wy2),
                self.X * (xy2 + wz2) + self.Y * (1.0 - xx2 - zz2) + self.Z * (yz2 - wx2),
                self.X * (xz2 - wy2) + self.Y * (yz2 + wx2) + self.Z * (1.0 - xx2 - yy2));
    }

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): rotation * self.
    Multiply(rotation: Quaternion, self: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => self.Transform(rotation);

    // Apply only the linear part of a homogeneous map: the translation row is
    // skipped, as it must be for displacements and normals.
    TransformNormal(self: Vector3D, matrix: Matrix4x4): Vector3D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + self.Z * matrix.Row3.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Y,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Z + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Z + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Z);

    // The combined hash of the components.
    Hash(self: Vector3D): Integer
        => self.X.Hash.CombineHash(self.Y.Hash).CombineHash(self.Z.Hash);

    //==
    // # Integer vectors — concrete bodies
    //
    // IHashable obligations for the fixed-arity integer tuples declared in
    // `vectors.types.plato`.

    Hash(self: IntegerVector2): Integer
        => self.X.Hash * 31 + self.Y.Hash;

    Hash(self: IntegerVector3): Integer
        => ((self.X.Hash * 31 + self.Y.Hash) * 31 + self.Z.Hash);

    Hash(self: IntegerVector4): Integer
        => (((self.X.Hash * 31 + self.Y.Hash) * 31 + self.Z.Hash) * 31 + self.W.Hash);

    //==
    // # Portable bodies for the numeric tuples
    //
    // The concrete per-component operations on Number2 / Number3 / Number4 /
    // Number8 (`vectors.types.plato`). These used to be bodiless
    // declarations in `intrinsics.library.plato` forwarded to System.Numerics;
    // they are ordinary Plato now, so the host contract mentions only primitive
    // types. A backend may still substitute a native vector instruction for any of
    // them through its representation map and override table — these bodies define
    // what that substitution must compute.
    //
    // The generic component-wise surface in
    // `numeric-structures.library.plato` computes the same values through
    // Map/Zip over ComponentArray; the fixed-arity bodies here are the ones a
    // backend can map onto a single SIMD instruction, and they are written out lane
    // by lane for exactly that reason.
    //
    // Semantics match System.Numerics: Multiply and Divide of two tuples are
    // component-wise (Hadamard), never a dot product; Length is the Euclidean norm;
    // Clamp / Min / Max act per component; Number4.Transform follows the ROW-vector
    // convention v' = v M (CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices).

    //==
    // # Number2

    // The squared Euclidean length; avoids the square root.
    LengthSquared(self: Number2): Number
        => self.X * self.X + self.Y * self.Y;

    // The Euclidean length.
    Length(self: Number2): Number
        => self.LengthSquared.Sqrt;

    // Component-wise absolute value.
    Abs(self: Number2): Number2
        => (self.X.Abs, self.Y.Abs);

    // Component-wise square root. Precondition: no component is negative.
    Sqrt(self: Number2): Number2
        => (self.X.Sqrt, self.Y.Sqrt);

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(left: Number2, right: Number2): Number2
        => (left.X + right.X, left.Y + right.Y);

    // Component-wise difference.
    Subtract(left: Number2, right: Number2): Number2
        => (left.X - right.X, left.Y - right.Y);

    // Component-wise (Hadamard) product, not a dot product.
    Multiply(left: Number2, right: Number2): Number2
        => (left.X * right.X, left.Y * right.Y);

    // Every component scaled by a scalar.
    Multiply(left: Number2, scalar: Number): Number2
        => (left.X * scalar, left.Y * scalar);
```
